_comment: Open-weights fine-tuning presets. Targets are Meta model ids (muse-glimmer, muse-spark-open); base weights resolve via HF_MODEL_REPO env so no registry URL is hardcoded. Hyperparameters per target reflect size: glimmer distills short verdicts, spark-open distills full receipt-cited findings.

muse-glimmer.description: Small on-device chat model: distill short damage verdicts (no-damage vs measured) from receipts. Smoke-tested in CI without weights.

muse-spark-open.description: Open-weights findings model (Baseten mirror of Spark): distill full receipt-cited findings drafts with gate-shaped outputs.
